crossRefs.note: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.
Now therefore this is what Yahweh of Armies says: Consider your ways.

translations.web: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.
translations.bsb: Each one must examine himself before he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup.
translations.kjv: But let ➔ a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
translations.asv: But let a man prove himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.
